# Load Libraries and Datasets
```{r}
rm(list=ls())
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
access <- read_csv("data/processed/10th Percentile Access Tracts.csv")
prscrb <- read_csv("data/processed/Providers with Geographic Location.csv")
```

# Clean combined CMS/Prscrb Dataset
```{r}
prscrbr_sf <- prscrb %>%
  filter(!is.na(latitude) & !is.na(longitude)) %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
    crs = 4326)

providers_no_geo <- prscrb %>% filter(is.na(latitude) | is.na(longitude) | is.na(address)) %>% select(NPI, Provider_Type, latitude, longitude, address)


```

# Summary of Providers without a Location
```{r}
provider_table <- providers_no_geo %>%
  group_by(Provider_Type) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `N (%)` = paste0(n, " (", round(100 * n / sum(n), 1), "%)")
  ) %>%
  select(Provider_Type, `N (%)`) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = ""
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Provider_Type = "Provider Type",
    `N (%)` = "N (%)"
  ) %>%
  cols_width(
    Provider_Type ~ px(140),
    `N (%)` ~ px(100)
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 11
  )
provider_table
gtsave(
  provider_table,
  "figures/Providers with no location Table.png"
)
```

# Table of Total Providers with Location Data:
```{r}
provider_table <- prscrbr_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(Provider_Type) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `N (%)` = paste0(n, " (", round(100 * n / sum(n), 1), "%)")
  ) %>%
  select(Provider_Type, `N (%)`) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = ""
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Provider_Type = "Provider Type",
    `N (%)` = "N (%)"
  ) %>%
  cols_width(
    Provider_Type ~ px(140),
    `N (%)` ~ px(100)
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 11
  )
provider_table
gtsave(
  provider_table,

```

# Reduce data to bottom 10 percentile tracts: 
```{r}
tracts <- tigris::tracts(cb = TRUE, year = 2024)
prscrbr_reduced <- prscrbr_sf %>%
  st_join(
    tracts_sf %>%
      filter(GEOID %in% access$GEOID) %>%
      select(GEOID) %>%
      st_transform(st_crs(prscrbr_sf)),
    join = st_within,
    left = FALSE
  )

provider_table <- prscrbr_reduced %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(Provider_Type) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    `Reported Beneficiaries` = sum(!is.na(beneficiaries)),
    `No Reported Beneficiaries` = sum(is.na(beneficiaries)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `N (%)` = paste0(
      n, " (", round(100 * n / sum(n), 1), "%)"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Provider_Type,
    `N (%)`,
    `Reported Beneficiaries`,
    `No Reported Beneficiaries`
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = ""
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Provider_Type = "Provider Type",
    `N (%)` = "N (%)",
    `Reported Beneficiaries` = "Providers w/ Reported Beneficiaries",
    `No Reported Beneficiaries` = "Providers w/o Reported Beneficiaries"
  ) %>%
  cols_width(
    Provider_Type ~ px(140),
    `N (%)` ~ px(100),
    `Reported Beneficiaries` ~ px(180),
    `No Reported Beneficiaries` ~ px(180)
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 11
  )
provider_table
gtsave(
  provider_table,
  "figures/Providers in 10th Percentile with location Table.png")

provider_plot <- prscrbr_reduced %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  count(Provider_Type) %>%
  mutate(
    pct = n / sum(n) * 100
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = "", y = pct, fill = Provider_Type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percent (%)",
    fill = "Provider Type"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-5, 105),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )
provider_plot
ggsave(
  "figures/Providers in 10th Percentile bar chart.png",
  provider_plot,
  width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)


provider_table <- prscrbr_reduced %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(Provider_Type) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    bene = if (all(is.na(beneficiaries))) {
      "unknown"
    } else {
      as.character(sum(beneficiaries, na.rm = TRUE))
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `N (%)` = paste0(n, " (", round(100 * n / sum(n), 1), "%)")
  ) %>%
  select(Provider_Type, `N (%)`, bene) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "") %>%
  cols_label(
    Provider_Type = "Provider Type",
    `N (%)` = "N (%)",
    bene = "Reported Beneficiaries"
  ) %>%
  cols_width(
    Provider_Type ~ px(140),
    `N (%)` ~ px(100),
    bene ~ px(120)
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 11
  )
provider_table
gtsave(
  provider_table,
  "figures/Providers in 10th Percentile (beneficiaries) Table.png")
```
